newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Woodchester says Credit Lyonnais to sell.
newsitem.headline: Woodchester says Credit Lyonnais to sell.

text.p: Irish financial services group Woodchester Investments Plc said on Thursday that Credit Lyonnais will sell its 54 percent shareholding in the group once it receives a price which reflects the full value of its interest.
Woodchester said given the level of Credit Lyonnais' stake any such disposal will lead to a full bid for the Woodchester Group.

"Credit Lyonnais indicated that, subject to receiving a price which reflects the full value of their 54 percent interest...they wish to sell their shareholding," Woodchester said in a results statement.
The Irish financial services group said it has appointed joint advisers, Chase Investment Bank and Goldman Sachs to seek suitable buyers.
"The parties will work in the interest of all shareholders to achieve a price which reflects the true value of your group," Woodchester said.
It said it was confident of receiving a high level of interest from prospective purchasers.
Woodchester reported a 22 percent increase in pre-tax profits to 44.3 million Irish pounds in 1996.
